card.name: Small linking words in label phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words or word starts (into, or, other, Pan, 3) that sit just before a specific term the label text then supplies, such as breast milk, CRC, psychiatric disorders, or pancreatic.

modes.label: Linking word before a condition
modes.description: Words like 'other' or 'or' right after a disease name, before another condition or group.

modes.label: Start of a split name or number
modes.description: The first piece of a trial or cancer name, or a number in a combined dose.

modes.label: Preposition before body fluid
modes.description: The word 'into' after a drug passes into breast milk.
modes.example: Tranylcypromine sulfate passes<< into>> your breast milk. Do not breastfeed
